'''Sarthon Quis''' was a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] who was among the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]<ref name="Codex" /> after their [[Unidentified refugee transport|transport]] crashed there during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture.<ref name="History">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|The History of Makeb}}</ref> The survivors were soon plagued by attacks from [[exoboar]]s, vicious and heavily-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] burrowing animals native to Makeb's [[Cave/Legends|caves]]; however, Quis determined that exoboars were repelled by a certain [[Unidentified Makeb herb|type]] of [[Plant/Legends|herb]] that grew in Makeb's caves.<ref name="Codex" />

By rubbing the herb on their [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]], the settlers were able to pass by exoboars safely, and Quis went on to become a famed exoboar hunter&mdash;though the set of armor made from exoboar hide that he wore eventually led to his [[Death/Legends|death]]. A [[subteroth]], a predator of the exoboar, devoured Quis while he was leading an expedition deeper into the caves, as the subteroth believed he was a large exoboar.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sarthon Quis was mentioned in the Codex entry for exoboars in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
